digest.component_or_area: Rebar Agent LLM run accounting and failure translation
propositions: Successful Agent runs with multiple retry attempts must report aggregated usage (sum of all attempts) in exactly one durable JSONL row, without per-attempt row emission or rejected-output subtraction.

Validation-failure exhaustion must re-raise the identical original Rebar StructuredOutputError object by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain (UnexpectedModelBehavior -> ToolRetryError -> ModelRetry -> StructuredOutputError); repeated-truncation exhaustion with no Rebar object in the cause chain must construct a fresh UnretryableOutputError as the defined fallback.
Terminal failure must preserve consumed requests and tokens without creating fictional usage values, and must capture complete final provider response artifacts only when artifact policy is enabled.

Consumed usage counters must exclude candidate_requests or competing request-budget fields, and no new core usage field must be introduced to maintain backward compatibility with historical pricing and usage reports.
